label: Text
purpose: A block of rich text content, or (inside horizontal-ticker) a single ticker message
_notes:
Two different real components share this block type name. In image-with-text/main-product, only 'text' (richtext, MUST be wrapped in

tags) applies — leave 'title' out. Inside horizontal-ticker, only 'title' (plain text, one short ticker message) applies — leave 'text' out. Never fill both. In horizontal-ticker, add 8-10 blocks minimum for smooth scrolling and give EACH block unique, different content — never repeat the same message.
